title: Unit Testing Agent Tools with Pytest & Mocks
why: You must not make live calls to paid LLM APIs during automated test runs. Testing agent code requires mocking tool responses and verifying edge cases deterministically.
objectives: Mock external API calls using unittest.mock
Assert tool output schemas and error handling
concept: Mocks simulate API responses instantly without network dependencies or API costs, ensuring rapid CI/CD test runs.

code.content:
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock
import pytest

def fetch_user_data(user_id: int) -> dict:
    # Imagine this hits a real database or API
    import requests
    resp = requests.get(f'https://api.example.com/users/{user_id}')
    return resp.json()

# Test using pytest and mock
@patch('requests.get')
def test_fetch_user_data(mock_get):
    mock_response = MagicMock()
    mock_response.json.return_value = {'id': 42, 'name': 'Aditi Rao', 'role': 'Engineer'}
    mock_get.return_value = mock_response
    
    data = fetch_user_data(42)
    assert data['id'] == 42
    assert data['name'] == 'Aditi Rao'
    mock_get.assert_called_once_with('https://api.example.com/users/42')
    print('\n✅ Pytest mock verified successfully!')
